notes: Blog (Góc Luật Sư) hero images, keyed by the imageKey each post in content/drafts/posts-batch-*.json references. Reuse-first: the generator semantically matches against the shared R2 pool and only generates the gaps. After generation, scripts/import-images-to-media.mjs imports the resulting assets.json into the Media collection (key = id) and import-posts.mjs links each post's heroImage by imageKey.
